artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: The image shows a man crucified on a cross, a woman to the left and another man to the right. Above, there is a deity surrounded by clouds and angels, and the intricate border features floral patterns and smaller angelic figures. The background includes trees and a clear sky.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene with two armored horses and riders. One rider is wearing elaborate armor and is carrying a lance and banner, accompanied by a heraldic lion figure. Another armored horse appears to have fallen with its rider represented by an animal form tangled in armor and limbs. The background includes clouds and dynamic lines. The artwork emphasizes dramatic and humorous elements using detailed linework and contrasting positions of the two figures.

artworks.title: Masquerade Dance with Torches
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed irregularly to block): 22.7 × 25 cm (8 15/16 × 9 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group dance in a medieval or renaissance setting. In the center of the image, figures in period costumes partake in a formal dance on a checkered floor. The dancers are dressed in elaborate garments typical of the Renaissance era, with capes, patterned tunics, and feather-adorned hats. The background features an upper level where additional observers, dressed in similar ornate attire, peer over a balcony. Ornamentations and architectural details enrich the setting, giving it a sense of grandeur and nobility. The woodcut technique emphasizes the textures and details of the characters’ outfits and the decorating elements surrounding them.

artworks.title: The Virgin Surrounded by Many Angels
artworks.description: The image is a detailed engraving showing several figures. In the center is a seated woman holding a child. The woman has a halo and a floral crown, long curly hair, and is dressed in flowing robes with intricate patterns. Surrounding them are winged angels and cherubs, each with unique hairstyles and features. Some angels hold floral bouquets, while others have instruments. In the background, two large angels hold a crown over the woman’s head, with swirling clouds and more angelic figures. The composition is highly detailed, with elaborate clothing, wings, and expressions on each character, creating a celestial atmosphere.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms of the German Empire and Nuremberg City
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a heraldic composition with allegorical elements. The image includes two winged figures seated on clouds at the top, holding symbols of justice and abundance. Below them, a crowned double-headed eagle emblem is featured. Additional winged figures on either side appear to be supporting shields bearing smaller heraldic symbols. The style of the drawing indicates an intricate and orderly execution, typical of early 16th-century engravings.

artworks.title: Ulrich Varnbüler
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person's upper body up to the chest, displayed in profile facing to the right. The person has a strong facial structure with a prominent nose and slightly tilted-up head. He has a curly short beard, and his hair is mostly covered by a large, elaborate hat. The person is wearing a high-collared garment with visible stitching and layered fabric. Near the right side of the image, there is a decorative inscription in Latin on a scroll. The background consists of fine horizontal lines, creating a textured backdrop for the portrait.

artworks.title: Ulrich Varnbüler
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to block): 43 x 33 cm (16 15/16 x 13 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed portrait of a man in a profile view. He has distinct facial features, with a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a jutting chin. He has a beard and hair on his chin and sideburns, partially covered by an elaborate hat. The man wears a garment with padded shoulders and a low neckline, and there are no visible accessories in his hands. The background is dark with woodcut lines, contrasting with the tan tones of his face and clothing. An inscription "ULRICHVS VARNBVLER" and a decorative scroll with Latin text are visible in the image.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures seated around a long table. A table is centered in the drawing, covered with a cloth and various items placed upon it. Several figures are leaning over the table from both sides. Behind them, the background suggests a wall with lined texture and small windows. A round, luminous object is depicted above the central figure. The architecture and furnishings depicted have a medieval or Renaissance quality.

artworks.title: Justice, Truth and Reason in the Stocks with the Seated Judge and Sleeping Piety
artworks.description: This drawing depicts figures representing virtues and vices in an allegorical scene. The central figures are labeled 'Gerechtigkeit' (Justice), 'Warhatt' (Truth), and 'Vernunft' (Reason). Justice holds a sword, while another authoritative figure on the right holds a rod and sits on a throne-like chair labeled 'Ich bin die frucht'. An infant is depicted in a cradle below this figure. The artwork includes symbolic characters and text elements in a style similar to woodcut illustrations from the late medieval or early Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Helius Eobanus Hessus
artworks.medium: woodcut and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed half-length portrait of a man in profile facing left. He is seated and wears a hat with wide brim and folds that frame his curly hair and a thick beard. His attire includes a cloak draped over his shoulders with visible layered fabric, and he's holding a scroll or paper in his right hand. There is no visible jewelry. The background of the image is a simple, empty interior space. The portrait is part of a printed document, which includes large headings at the top and columns of text below the image.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Chariot of Maximilian I (The Great Triumphal Car)
artworks.medium: woodcut printed from eight blocks and letterpress on eight joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate procession featuring a grand chariot pulled by several horses. The drawing depicts a highly detailed and intricately designed procession scene with a luxurious chariot as its centerpiece. The chariot is richly adorned with intricate patterns, sculptures, and emblems. Each component of the procession is intricately labeled with Latin inscriptions. The procession is pulled by bands of horses, each pair adorned with decorative armor. There are mythological creatures and decorative elements surrounding the chariot wheel and on the chariot itself. Various attributes, symbols, and decorative motifs fill this drawing.

artworks.title: Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This round print shows a scene with five people in an outdoor landscape. On the right are three nude women, two of them facing us, and one facing the left. In the bottom left, an armored man reclines on the ground. He has long hair and appears to have a weapon at his side, and his head is turned to the left, away from the women. Behind him is another man with a long white beard who wears a robe and holds a round object out to the armored man. All of the people have light skin. The landscape is filled with dark crosshatching lines and includes trees and architectural elements in the distance. Surrounding the round print is off-white paper.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms of Lazarus Spengler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic emblem enclosed in an architectural frame. The artwork features a coat of arms at the center, supported by scrollwork and topped with a crown figure with wings. The composition is framed by classical columns and arches with decorative elements and a scroll inscribed with text located below the emblem. The emblem is rich with detailed line work, typical of heraldic imagery.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms of the Kress von Kressenstein Family
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate coat of arms showing a symmetrical design featuring an intricately detailed heraldic shield adorned with floral and vine motifs. The shield prominently displays a sword, angled diagonally from top left to bottom right. Above the shield, there is a classic bearded helmet crowned with an ornate crest of feathers and a crown. Flowing acanthus leaves emanate from the base of the helmet, framing the composition. The drawing is meticulously rendered in monochrome, showcasing the artist's attention to linework and detail.

artworks.title: Saints Maximilian, Stephen, and Valentine
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in the foreground. The central figure is standing slightly turned to the left, holding a large quill or branch. This person has a youthful face, short curly hair, and wears a robe with wide sleeves. Flanking this central figure on either side are two dignified figures adorned with ornate vestments, likely ecclesiastical robes, and elaborate mitres. They stand on a platform. In the background, there is an arch with scrollwork and decorative elements. Two cherubs are perched on columns on either side. Below the figures are two crests and a bishop's mitre. The scene is rendered in an intricate line drawing style, typical of a classic woodcut or engraving.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms of Hector Pömer
Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: silverpoint heightened with white on brown prepared paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows a person's head and shoulders facing slightly left. The individual has a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, thin, arched eyebrows, a faint mustache, and a thin mouth that is slightly downturned. They have long, flowing hair that is textured and wavy, extending past their shoulders. At their neck is a visible collar or garment top. The background is off-white paper. There are faint handwritten inscriptions and a faint signature or monogram in the upper left.

artworks.title: The Embrace (A Couple of Lovers by a Tree)
Riva degli Schiavoni, No. 2
artworks.medium: etching and roulette in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a harbor scene viewed from an elevated perspective. The scene includes a busy quay and sailboats docked by the water. Buildings and ships line the waterfront with sailboat masts reaching upwards. The artwork is detailed with fine lines, portraying people and ships. The color palette is monochromatic using varying shades of black. Figures are seen interacting in the foreground, with harbor structures and vessels behind them. Architectural details are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Riva degli Schiavoni, No. 1
artworks.medium: etching and roulette in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy port scene seen from an elevated perspective. Buildings line the horizon, seamlessly transitioning into the sky. The artwork features detailed linework and a monochromatic color palette of black and white. Figures are scattered across a paved surface, with ships moored in the water nearby.

artworks.title: Village Festival
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a village scene with various activities and events. The image captures a bustling atmosphere with characters engaged in activity. The scene includes rustic buildings with wooden beams and thatched roofs. In the foreground, there are animals, including chickens and a dog. Barrels and baskets are present. 

On the right side, there is a raised platform with banners and flags, where figures appear to be performing or addressing a crowd. The central area is crowded with people dancing or interacting. Various postures and facial expressions emphasize the lively spirit of the scene. The background shows more of the village with trees and structures.

artworks.title: Violin Player Seated in a Tavern
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic interior scene with multiple figures interacting. It depicts a warm and bustling interior of a rural establishment, possibly a tavern or common room. The room is filled with elements like wooden furniture and hanging pots, suggesting a well-used space. In the foreground, a person plays a violin, contributing to the lively atmosphere. Other elements include individuals engaged in conversation and activities, creating a sense of community. The architecture and furnishings, such as a ladder, bench, and barrels, indicate a rustic setting. Details like the wooden ceiling, wall-mounted shelves, and a fireplace add authenticity to the scene.

artworks.title: A King and Diana Receiving Huntsmen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.6 × 40 cm (8 7/8 × 15 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring several figures in a landscape with a detailed cityscape in the background. The figures are engaged in conversation or preparation, some adorned in robes and holding objects like a scepter or shield. Hounds are resting nearby, while other figures stand holding spears or shepherd staffs, one of whom seems to be managing a group of dogs. The city in the background displays towers, bridges, and buildings, set against a backdrop of hills and forests. The artwork has detailed line work and complex compositions.
